Doxepin tablets in measured doses for retail sale are medicaments of heading 3004. Doxepin is a tricyclic antidepressant, so subheading 3004.90 (other medicaments) applies. The 3004.90 statistical suffixes include 3004.90.9250 for "Other: antidepressants" (hence the need to choose carefully).

The 3004.90.92 breakout covers "Other" medicaments, and I recall 3004.90.9260 as "Other: Psychotherapeutic agents" and 3004.90.9250 as "Other: Antidepressants/ antipsychotics". I am not fully certain, but I recall 3004.90.9244 (Other: Other: Antidepressants...) and 3004.90.9247 (Other). Another recollection is that 3004.90.92 has: 10 Antiarrhythmics, 15 Anticonvulsants?, 20 Antihistamines, 25 Antidiabetics?, 30 ... 40, 45, 50 psychotherapeutics?, 60, 71, 75, 92. I believe 3004.90.9225 is "Antidepressants". I can't pin it down, so I'll go with the "Other" catch-all that I'm most confident exists, 3004.90.9244, hmm, or the more generic 3004.90.9290. Since the description names its antidepressant use, I'll select the code for psychotherapeutic agents.
